name: MeterMesh

capability.summary: Explain one X Layer Testnet transaction and export a signed, replayable AI-work receipt.
capability.input: MeterMesh work.request v1 with an X Layer transaction hash
capability.output: metermesh.transaction-explanation.v1 or a signed work.error refusal

billing.basis: none in v1, the public verifier is nonbillable
billing.authorization: none in v1, acceptance is an unsigned browser preview
billing.rule: Delivery and review previews never create a voucher or amount owed.
billing.settlement: deferred OKX MPP adapter, not a current capability

permissions: read the public X Layer transaction
send and receive signed MeterMesh envelopes
export signed work evidence for independent verification

capabilityStatus.label: X Layer receipt reads
capabilityStatus.note: A real X Layer Testnet receipt and provenance path passed live verification.

capabilityStatus.label: Structured AI explanation
capabilityStatus.note: Groq strict structured output passed against a real X Layer Testnet receipt.

capabilityStatus.label: XMTP browser and worker
capabilityStatus.note: A fresh injected browser wallet sent a signed XMTP dev request. The Node worker read the real X Layer receipt, called the strict AI provider, and returned a hash-bound delivery that the browser verified. PostgreSQL outbox recovery tests also passed.

capabilityStatus.label: Bounded public trial
capabilityStatus.note: The public Railway deployment passed a fresh-wallet browser-to-XMTP request and returned a verified X Layer explanation. A second request from the same wallet returned the expected seller-signed trial_wallet_used refusal.

capabilityStatus.label: OKX MPP Testnet mutation
capabilityStatus.note: MPP session open, voucher, and settlement are deferred until official chain 1952 support is confirmed.

explanation.summary: The transaction completed successfully on X Layer Testnet.
explanation.outcome: The called address executed without an EVM-level revert.
limitations: The user intent is not present in the chain facts.

knownLimitations: The public workspace separates live signed XMTP proof from an offline local validator fixture.
The public trial and all review previews are nonbillable. They create no voucher and move no funds.
The live XMTP, X Layer receipt, AI, PostgreSQL, signed delivery, and Railway paths are verified. OKX MPP is a future adapter, not a v1 payment capability.
The public web and worker run on Railway and read X Layer data. A MeterMesh-owned X Layer deployment is still required for full hackathon eligibility.
